framework.notes:
- Disabled mods are now COMPLETELY inert: the framework previously ran every
  mod's load code and only skipped its "enable" step, so mods doing their
  work at load (custom gambits, for one) ignored the toggle entirely. A
  disabled mod's DLL is no longer even loaded; enabling it from the manager
  or the console loads it on the spot.
- Gambit mods no longer haunt your save: uninstalling or disabling a custom
  gambit used to leave its unlock entry in the game's save data forever -
  the collection said "201/200" and showed stale entries. GambitApi now
  sweeps orphaned gambit ids out of the save on startup.
- Collection screen: the pagination patch no longer re-enforces slot
  visibility every frame (a frame-rate sink via constant UI layout
  rebuilds), and GambitApi logs a one-time frame-rate diagnostic the first
  time the collection stays open, so any remaining slowdown shows up in
  Player.log with numbers attached.
- SpeedMod retired: Gambonanza 1.4.0 added its own game-speed setting, so
  the mod is gone from the samples, the registry and future releases.

manager.notes:
- New knight. The app icon, the header logo and the website all wear the
  redrawn brand knight - same wine-and-cream palette, sharper profile, and
  an ear it was sorely missing.

mods.name: Bougie's Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: Every time you spend money, earn $1 back.
mods.description: A rare utility gambit that hooks the game's coin-spent event: whenever your money goes down (including strains), you immediately earn $1 back, complete with the floating money animation. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

latest.notes: Added Domino Effect's Gambit, Fixed a game-breaking bug in Recursion's gambit

mods.name: Crybaby's Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: Every turn, each of your threatened pieces also counts as a capture, firing capture-triggered effects.
mods.description: On each player turn, right after threats are marked, every one of your pieces under threat fires the game's capture event as if it had been captured - the piece stays on the board, but anything that triggers on captures goes off. The author notes a known issue: starting a second game in the same session can leave your pieces unresponsive. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

latest.notes: Added Domino Effect's Gambit, Fixed a game-breaking bug in Recursion's gambit

mods.name: Domino Effect's Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: When an enemy piece is trapped, trap every enemy piece adjacent to it.
mods.description: Trapping an enemy piece chains outward: every untrapped adjacent black piece gets trapped too, and each of those re-fires the trigger, so a well-placed trap can cascade across a cluster. Hooks both the hunter-tile and piece trap events. Epic rarity, priced at 8. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

latest.notes: Added Domino Effect's Gambit, Fixed a game-breaking bug in Recursion's gambit

mods.name: Enemy Threat Overlay
mods.author: nikaakaa
mods.summary: Hold Space to light up every square the enemy can reach.
mods.description: A board overlay that shows enemy coverage while you hold the key, so you can see the trap before you walk into it. Rebind the key from the in-game console (F10).

mods.name: Fishing Net's Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: When an enemy piece is trapped, skip the enemy's turn.
mods.description: A rare trap-focused gambit: whenever an enemy piece gets trapped (hunter tiles included), the enemy's next turn is skipped, turning every trap into free tempo. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

latest.notes: Added Domino Effect's Gambit, Fixed a game-breaking bug in Recursion's gambit

mods.name: Gambit Creation API
mods.author: Ben
mods.summary: Library other mods use to build and register custom gambits.
mods.description: Not much to look at on its own - install it because another mod asked for it. It gives mod authors a small API for defining a gambit (art, rarity, trigger, effect) and registering it with the game at runtime.

mods.name: GrandMa's Cookies' Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: At the start of a game, earn one random piece.
mods.description: A splice of two vanilla gambits: GrandMa's Gift's framing with Chrysalis' trigger, so every run starts with one bonus random piece in your stock (skipped if the stock is already full). Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

latest.notes: Added Domino Effect's Gambit, Fixed a game-breaking bug in Recursion's gambit

mods.name: Jumper Cables' Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: After every move, a 1/5 chance to trigger one of your gambits unconditionally.
mods.description: An EPIC-rarity gambit that rolls a 1-in-5 chance through the game's own chance system after every move; on success it fires one of the gambits you currently own, picked at random, ignoring their usual trigger conditions. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

latest.notes: Added Domino Effect's Gambit, Fixed a game-breaking bug in Recursion's gambit

mods.name: Junk's Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: A joke gambit that does nothing; its card text re-rolls to a random rule description each time it appears.
mods.description: A one-coin prank card: the gambit itself has no gameplay effect (its trigger only plays the standard visual effect), but every time the card appears its description is re-rolled from a pool of 25 texts that mostly restate vanilla game rules, so it always claims to do something it doesn't. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

latest.notes: Added Domino Effect's Gambit, Fixed a game-breaking bug in Recursion's gambit

mods.name: Recursion's Gambit
mods.author: Agent15
mods.summary: Repeating your previous move exactly (same piece, same distance, same direction) skips the enemy's turn.
mods.description: An epic gambit that remembers your last move: repeat it exactly with the same piece, the same distance, in the same direction, and the enemy's next turn is skipped. Move history resets between rounds; the author notes a known trigger quirk around crumbled tiles. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.

latest.notes: Added Domino Effect's Gambit, Fixed a game-breaking bug in Recursion's gambit
